notes: FogBugz → Jira: the description now arrives in Jira. The FogBugz API returns the case body in a different column (sHtml) than JKit read — the original description is now picked up reliably and converted to rich text instead of being dropped. The same fix applies to FB → Jira comment sync. FogBugz → Jira: the FogBugz milestone is now mapped to a Jira fix version (resolved against the project's real version list, editable in the preview). 'Undecided' stays without fix version. FogBugz → Jira: the FogBugz case now gets a 'JLink: <url>' entry pointing to the new Jira issue, alongside the [KEY] title prefix (legacy behaviour restored). FogBugz → Jira: the FogBugz case number is written into the Jira 'External issue ID (migrated)' field, with the same write-and-verify logic the Jira → FogBugz direction uses. FogBugz → Jira: the Jira 'Team' field is set to 'CAM' on every created issue (configurable via [jira_defaults] in user-overrides.toml). FogBugz → Jira: the new Jira issue is assigned to the Metamation queue account, and the 'TMMCreated' label is now applied to every migrated issue — the checkbox only controls the additional 'NoReleaseNotes' label + close-as-Done step. The result panel now shows a status pill for each post-create step (JLink, External issue ID, Team, Assignee, fix version) so silent failures are visible.
